from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u059/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-97f687cf.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    baseline = max(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    heights = {2: 4, 8: 3}
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[baseline]):
        if value in heights:
            height = min(heights[value], baseline)
            top = baseline - height
            out[top][c] = value
            for r in range(top + 1, baseline):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
test=[[0]*11 for _ in range(9)]
test[6]=[1,2,1,8,1,1,1,8,1,2,1]
ns={}
exec(source, ns)
answer=ns['transform'](test)
print(answer)
